{{Top|leg}}
'''Imperial File #312485.36cc''' was an internal [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] report containing reports from various sources that [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was part of an active [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] cell operating on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
